description: Discover the exclusivity of this sumptuous apartment on the 4th floor, offering a breathtaking view of the Champs de Mars and the Eiffel Tower. With 240 m2, 4 bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, a spacious living room and a dining area, this elegant place can accommodate up to 8 guests. The air-conditioned master bedroom ensures optimal comfort. Immerse yourself in absolute luxury in the heart of Paris...The spaceLocated on the top floor of a grand 19th-century building on Rue Savorgnan de Brazza, this exceptional 240 sqm apartment offers an incomparable vantage point over the Champs de Mars, with a direct, unobstructed view of the Eiffel Tower. The residence forms a continuous sequence of salons and living spaces framed by more than 3.5-meter-high ceilings, original architectural elements, and large windows that flood the interiors with natural light throughout the day.Recently redesigned while preserving the building’s historic character, the apartment blends classical Parisian features—ornate moldings, parquet de Versailles, marble fireplaces—with contemporary furnishings and subtle, curated décor. The atmosphere is both grand in scale and discreet in tone, allowing the architecture and views to speak for themselves.The living area unfolds into multiple interconnected rooms: a generous double reception space overlooking the Eiffel Tower, a dining room designed for hosting, and a fully equipped kitchen suitable for both daily meals and private chef experiences. Each room has been conceived to accommodate moments of conviviality as well as quiet retreat.The apartment features four spacious bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom.
